short: Functional Passivation Interface of LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 towa
title: Functional Passivation Interface of LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 toward Superior Lithium Storage

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Ni-rich NCM cathodes cycled to 4.5 V lose capacity and working voltage through side reactions at the cathode-electrolyte interface. A preformed P-based passivation interface on NCM should suppress those side reactions and give superior lithium storage.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/route), n5 (DES/variable_sweep), n6 (PRC/deposition), n10 (PRC/stimulus)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: An amorphous LiTMPO4 passivation layer 1-2 nm thick covers the NCM surface. After 50 cycles the modified electrode shows far fewer intergranular cracks in cross-section than the pristine one.
states.detail: Absorbed: n7 (STR/interface), n11 (STR/microstructure/damage), n12 (STR/phase/identity), n14 (STR/phase/fraction). Premises: Metastable Ni4+ formed at full charge is reduced to Ni2+ on extended cycling, driving layered-to-rock-salt decay; The three redox couples of Ni-rich layered oxides correspond to the H1-M, M-H2 and H2-H3 phase transitions

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Li+ migration across the LiNiO2/LiNiPO4 heterostructure costs only 0.11 eV, less than in either bulk phase. The preformed layer works as an artificial CEI: it keeps the electrolyte off the NCM surface and suppresses the side reactions that build an unstable CEI.
states.detail: Absorbed: n8 (PRP/descriptor), n9 (MEC/pathway), n13 (PRP/value), n18 (MEC/tradeoff). Premises: DFT with nudged-elastic-band Li migration, interface binding energies and density of states

states.title: Performance state
states.head: NCM-2 keeps about 92% of its capacity over 100 cycles at 0.25 C and still delivers about 117 mAh/g after 400 cycles. NCM-2 delivers the highest capacity of the four samples at every rate from 0.25 C to 25 C.

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: A PH3-grown LiTMPO4 passivation interface of optimised thickness gives Ni-rich NCM superior cycling, rate and voltage stability

nodes.title: MICRO, F1, F9
nodes.head: Primary-particle surfaces are smooth and featureless for the pristine powder and become granular and pitted after phosphorization, most strongly at the highest NaH2PO2 loading. In cross-section the cycled pristine particle is crossed by dark intergranular cracks that reach its interior, while the modified one shows fewer and mostly peripheral openings
nodes.solves: An amorphous LiTMPO4 passivation layer 1-2 nm thick covers the NCM surface
nodes.note: the four panels are not at one magnification (60.00 KX with a 200 nm bar in a, 50.00 KX in b, 60.00 KX with a 100 nm bar in c, 50.20 KX in d), and panel c looks smoother than panel b, so the monotonic roughening claimed in the text is not what the panels show grain boundaries are still visible in the modified cross-section, which matches the text's 'slightly relieved' rather than a crack-free particle
nodes.necessity_reason: n7, n11 keeps shown support from o3, o4, o8 after removal.

nodes.title: evidence, F8
nodes.head: From cycle 1 to 100 the dQ/dV peaks of the pristine sample lose up to a third of their height and move to lower voltage, while those of the modified sample almost coincide
nodes.solves: The reversible H1/M, M/H2 and H2/H3 transformations are maintained over 100 cycles in the modified cathode but progressively lost in the pristine one
nodes.note: read from the panels: the H2/H3 minimum of NCM-0 goes from about -395 to -230 Ah/V/g and the H1/M minimum from about -465 to -395, against about -470 to -440 and -470 to -460 for NCM-2
nodes.detail: o17: From cycle 1 to 100 the dQ/dV peaks of the pristine sample lose up to a third of their height and move to lower voltage, while those of the modified sample almost coincide
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n14 (o17).

nodes.title: MICRO, F9
nodes.head: After 50 cycles the pristine primary particles are buried under a continuous surface film and the secondary particle shows stripped patches, while the modified particles keep sharp facets
nodes.solves: The preformed layer works as an artificial CEI: it keeps the electrolyte off the NCM surface and suppresses the side reactions that build an unstable CEI
nodes.note: the orange arrows marking the stripping sit in the F9a inset only
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n9 (o19).

nodes.title: evidence, F4
nodes.head: From 2.5 C upward NCM-3 falls below every other sample, reaching about 60 mAh/g at 25 C against about 95 for the pristine NCM-0
nodes.solves: A thicker passivation layer protects better but throttles Li+ transport, so NCM-3 loses initial capacity and rate capability
nodes.note: the NCM-3 series also stops near cycle 66 in the recovery block; the text says only that a thick layer limits Li+ diffusion and lowers the initial capacity, never that the thickest layer ends up worse than the pristine sample at high rate
nodes.detail: o11: From 2.5 C upward NCM-3 falls below every other sample, reaching about 60 mAh/g at 25 C against about 95 for the pristine NCM-0
nodes.inner_audit: o11: the NCM-3 series also stops near cycle 66 in the recovery block; the text says only that a thick layer limits Li+ diffusion and lowers the initial capacity, never that the thickest layer ends up worse than the pristine sample at high rate

nodes.title: evidence, F6
nodes.head: GITT diffusion coefficients of the two samples lie on top of each other at 2-6e-12 cm2/s from the second cycle on, and only at the start of the first charge does the modified one dip to about 1.0e-12
nodes.note: at the 40th cycle the pristine sample is the higher of the two at the first and last points of the charge branch
nodes.detail: o14: GITT diffusion coefficients of the two samples lie on top of each other at 2-6e-12 cm2/s from the second cycle on, and only at the start of the first charge does the modified one dip to about 1.0e-12

nodes.solves: Interfacial resistance stays nearly constant over 50 cycles for the modified cathode but grows steadily for the pristine one
nodes.note: the 0-cycle semicircle of the modified electrode is the tallest of its three, but the Warburg onset is the same for all three

nodes.title: evidence, F2, F5, F7
nodes.head: The P 2p signal is flat for the pristine sample and resolves into a labelled P-O component near 133 eV plus a P-TM component near 130 eV for the two thicker layers. Polarization voltage climbs from 0.090 to 0.223 V over 100 cycles for NCM-0 but only to 0.171 and 0.174 V for NCM-2 and NCM-3.
nodes.op: assign features, compare across conditions, read characteristic point
nodes.note: the Ni 2p panel of the same figure carries an arrow labelled Ni-P near 851 eV on the modified traces; the lattice-O peak near 529 eV is weaker than the adsorbed-O peak near 532 eV in every sample all four curves converge near 0.10 V at cycle 10 and only then separate; the text reads the panel as a straight benefit of the passivation layer a gap does open between about 1.5 and 4 eV above the Fermi level, so only the states at E_F carry the metallic reading
